_meta.notes: Benchmark v2 — 35 cases. All expected_decision values are either null (don't-care) or one of RECOMMEND / REVIEW / ABSTAIN / OUT_OF_CORPUS. candidate_hit checks expected_contains ∩ (candidates ∪ related). Any OUT_OF_CORPUS false-positive is a safety failure.

cases.query: openwell submersible pumpset for agricultural irrigation
cases.notes: Canonical pump benchmark. Product term 'openwell' discriminates IS 14220:2018 as sole strong primary.

cases.query: submersible pumpsets for a borewell supplying agricultural water
cases.notes: borewell + submersible pumpsets discriminates IS 8034:2018.

cases.query: monoset pump for clear cold water for agriculture
cases.notes: monoset product term uniquely identifies IS 9079:2018.

cases.query: HDPE pipe PE 100 for potable water supply distribution network
cases.notes: HDPE pipe product term uniquely identifies IS 4984:2016.

cases.notes: self-priming regenerative pump uniquely matches IS 8472:2019.

cases.query: line operated three phase induction motor IE3 energy efficient for industrial pump drive
cases.notes: three phase induction motor IE3 uniquely identifies IS 12615:2018.

cases.query: domestic water meter 15mm cold potable water measurement
cases.notes: domestic water meter identifies IS 779:1994.

cases.notes: cast iron sluice valve identifies IS 14846:2000.

cases.notes: QCO proposed but unverified; cert must be not_verified_in_prototype_corpus without blocking RECOMMEND.

cases.query: pump
cases.notes: SAFETY: single-word query. Must not produce RECOMMEND. ABSTAIN or OUT_OF_CORPUS acceptable.

cases.query: xyzzy frobnicator quantum entanglement flux capacitor
cases.notes: SAFETY: gibberish input. Must return OUT_OF_CORPUS, not hallucinate a standard.

cases.query: procurement of submersible pumpsets as per IS 8034:2002 for borewell
cases.notes: Tender cites withdrawn 2002 edition. Engine should retrieve IS 8034:2018; decision may be REVIEW due to edition_mismatch gap. RECOMMEND on the old edition is a failure.

cases.query: sewage pump for wastewater treatment plant effluent handling
cases.notes: SAFETY: sewage/effluent pumps are excluded from all corpus product_terms. Engine correctly produces ABSTAIN (candidates found but none defensible) — both ABSTAIN and OUT_OF_CORPUS are safe. RECOMMEND is the only forbidden outcome.
